title: Tensor with globally strict-perfect coefficient sheaves preserves countable products
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme, and let $A_T$ be the ring sheaf of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Work in $D=D(\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\Proet},A_T))$, with the countable derived products of [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-limit]. Let $E\in D$ admit a bounded complex representative $E^\bullet$ such that every $E^j$ is a direct summand of $A_T^{N_j}$ for some finite integer $N_j$. For every countable family $(C_n)_{n\geq1}$ of objects of $D$, the canonical comparison induced by the product projections
$$
(R\!\prod_{n\geq1}C_n)\otimes_{A_T}^LE\longrightarrow R\!\prod_{n\geq1}(C_n\otimes_{A_T}^LE)
$$
is an isomorphism, functorially in $E$ and the family.

proof.text: Finite powers of the tensor unit are dualizable by induction using zero objects and binary biproducts. Dualizability passes to the given finite-free retracts. The tensor adjunction and independent-coefficient tensor colimit preservation make tensor by each term exact. Apply the independent-universe bounded-above flat criterion to obtain K-flatness. Tensoring mapping cones and the acyclic-cone criterion show that total tensor with P preserves quasi-isomorphisms. This proves finiteProjectiveTensorComplexRight_inverts and gives its canonical localization lift.

proof.text: Exact countable products over the completed coefficient ring supply adicDatumCountableAB4Star. Apply derivedCategory_countableProducts_core to identify the localized product cones with derived product cones. The localization comparison transfers product preservation of the complex tensor functor to the composite of Q and its localization lift. Essential surjectivity of Q supplies complex representatives of every countable family; transfer limitingness along the family isomorphism to prove that the lift preserves countable products. The canonical piComparison is consequently invertible.

proof.text: For coefficient functoriality, use the normalized one-K-flat representative comparison in ringedDerived_closed_symmetric_monoidal. Since P and P′ are K-flat, this comparison is natural on every complex in the other variable. Fully faithful precomposition with Q lifts it to an isomorphism between each localization lift and the corresponding fixed-coefficient derived tensor functor. Conjugate the derived tensor action of e by these isomorphisms. For any K-flat test C and any roof P ← S → P′ representing e, naturality of the one-K-flat comparison gives its required roof formula. For uniqueness choose a roof for e; its denominator tensored with C is invertible by the same comparison, so the formula determines each K-flat component. Resolve an arbitrary complex by a K-flat one. Naturality across its inverted augmentation determines every component, and localization extensionality proves equality.
